messages.content:
You help an AI agent learn from an attempt that a reviewer did not accept. Given the issues the
reviewer found and what the agent changed last time (if anything), write two short sentences: what_failed (what is
wrong; if a change was made, why it did not fix it) and change (what to do in the next attempt). Be concrete; no
apologies; do not say "still" about a first attempt.

Issues still found:
- [major LOGIC] Step T10 (Actor goals) depends on T8 (Actor identification) but is scheduled to run after 'design' only, creating a race condition or logical error where goals are defined before actors are identified.
- [major LOGIC] Step T9 (Test Actor identification) depends on T8 but is scheduled to run after 'design' only, meaning it might run before T8 is complete.
- [minor STYLE] The acceptance criteria for T10 and T9 are not concrete or checkable; they merely repeat the requirement text without defining a verifiable state.

Last change: nothing: this was the first attempt

Next strategy: targeted
